use_case_summary: Primary: automated email/ticket summarization to reduce agent read time and create concise TL;DRs
Secondary: auto-tagging for routing and SLA triggers (priority, department, fraud-risk), powering macros and triage queues
Tertiary: agent assist snippets (quick replies, suggested macros) + escalation detection to create incident tickets
technical_requirements: Latency: tag inference < 200ms p95 for prioritized queue; summarization acceptable up to 1s p95 for non-realtime
Throughput: sustain 6k reqs/min during peak without >10% latency degradation
Accuracy target: 85%+ intent-tag F1 in POC; summarization ROUGE-L baseline improvement vs current templated summaries
Integration: Zendesk app + webhook integration, Freshdesk adapter optional; ability to push tags into macros and trigger automations
Observability: token-level cost metrics, per-tag accuracy dashboards, audit logs for each automated edit
Fallbacks: route to smaller quantized model or rule-based classifier when capacity constrained; configurable circuit-breaker thresholds
acceptance_criteria: POC accuracy: tag F1 >= 0.85 on holdout set (2k tickets)
Latency: p95 tag inference < 200ms on assigned dedicated capacity during simulated 2x peak spike
Operational: audit log entries present for 100% automated tag decisions and visible in UI
